aspects.says: best-first solves only nodes whose bound is above the optimum, at the price of memory

aspects.says: breadth-first takes nodes in the order they were made
basis: section:Breadth-First Is the Rule to Avoid

aspects.says: first-fractional and most-fractional pick among the fractional variables without solving anything
basis: section:The Variable Rule Decides Which Fractional Variable to Split

aspects.says: strong branching scores a candidate by the product of its two children's bound drops
